_comment: Execution-result status mapping for scripts/sync-testlink-execution.js. Maps the ONE outcome derived per test case from the current run's execution ledger (scripts/lib/execution-ledger.js, testCaseOutcome) to a TestLink execution status. Outcomes: 'passed' (every linked unit explicitly passed), 'product_failure' (a failure the finalized failure analysis confirms as a product bug), 'blocked' (any other failure, flake, block, expected failure, partial or unclean execution, or an unattributed failing unit), 'not_run' (skipped, manual, or nothing executed). The script refuses a map where any outcome other than 'passed' reaches a passing status. Human-editable; never hardcoded. See docs/testlink-integration.md.

testlink_statuses._comment: The TestLink reportTCResult status code each status name sends.
